# qed3


## To Setup

$ source setup.sh


## Geometry data (Appendix B) for the refinement level L can be generated by

$ cd geometry

$ make

$ ./get_geometry.out L

$ ./simp.out L

$ ./dual.out L


Supply an argument to specify the Wilson coupling (e.g., $\beta = 1.4$):
$ ./a.out 1.4


## S2 check (Appendix C.3)

$ cd check_s2

$ ./ferm.out nmax

$ ./gauge.out nmax
